decision.rationale: The retained homepage presents podcast interviews and personal scholarly narratives; stories is the baseline, with explicit upcoming-show schedules separated.

rules.rationale: Upcoming-show metadata describes participation schedules, distinct from interviews.
Named story, testimonial and spotlight sections contain profiles or narratives.
Titles explicitly identify a profile or spotlight narrative.
Recipient, winner and congratulation titles report an outcome rather than an open application.
Titles explicitly identify a retrospective recap or highlights report.
Explicit opportunities and funding sections remain participation information within broader academic paths.
Named openings, funding and event sections describe participation; archived event pages retain their historical category.
Named help, service, policy, procedure and contact sections provide practical support.
Named news, announcement and update sections publish institutional reports.

fallback.rationale: The retained homepage presents podcast interviews and personal scholarly narratives; stories is the baseline, with explicit upcoming-show schedules separated.
